privacy.title: Privacy Policy and Data Protection Notice
privacy.intro: EngineerTrack records your internship activity so that your workplace mentor and your academic advisor can review and validate it. Your advisor creates an internship group and shares a code with you; joining that group is what links you to them. This notice explains what we store, why we store it, and the rights you have over it. It applies to all users of the app.
privacy.dataWeCollect:
Account details: first and last name, e-mail address, role, and interface language.
Study details: university, faculty, department, and student number, as you enter them yourself.
Internship group: the code you join with, which group you belong to, and the dates you joined and left it.
Workplace details: company name, address, sector, and internship start and end dates.
Internship records: your daily log entries, the hours you record, your self-assessment scores, and the photos and documents you upload.
Mentor and advisor input: competency ratings, written feedback, approval and validation decisions.
Progress data: XP, level, streaks, and badges.
Technical data: a push notification token used only to deliver notifications to your device.
privacy.notCollected: We do not collect your location, your contacts, your device identifiers for advertising, or any analytics tracking of your behaviour outside the app. We do not sell any data and we do not share it with advertisers.
privacy.whyWeCollect:
To let you record your internship and to let your mentor and advisor review, rate, and validate it — this is the core service you signed up for.
To produce the reports your advisor needs to grade or certify your internship.
To operate the motivation features (XP, levels, badges, and the leaderboard within your own internship group).
To send you notifications about feedback, approvals, and validations.
privacy.sharing:
Your daily log entries, uploads and self-assessments are visible to the workplace mentor and the academic advisor linked to your account, and to nobody else.
Your advisor additionally sees your name, your e-mail address, and the date you joined their internship group.
Other students in your group see your first name, the initial of your surname, your profile picture, and your score on the group leaderboard. They cannot see your logs, your feedback, or your e-mail address.
There is no administrator role in EngineerTrack. Your advisor is the only person who manages the group you belong to.
privacy.retention: Internship records are kept for as long as your university needs them to certify the internship, and are deleted on request once that purpose ends. If you later join a different internship group, the records from your previous group stay with that group, so the advisor who supervised you keeps the evidence they certified. Account details are kept until you ask us to delete your account.
privacy.yourRights: You may ask to see the data we hold about you, to correct anything inaccurate, to have your data deleted, or to receive a copy of it. You may also withdraw this consent, though doing so means the app can no longer be used, because recording and reviewing internship data is its only function.
privacy.contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact your academic advisor through the app, or write to the EngineerTrack project team at the address published by your university.
